const d=$input.item.json;
const folderUrl=d.drive_folder_url||'';
const folderId=d.sub_folder_id||'';
const fileName=(d.subfolder_name||'ebook')+'.pdf';
const titleLine=d.topic?('Use this as the eBook title/topic: '+d.topic+'

'):'';
const msg='Create a complete, publication-ready AlfredAI eBook from the source material below, following your full end-to-end workflow (recall the AlfredAI knowledge and skill, read the references, research and verify current statistics with citations, write the full ebook copy in AlfredAI brand voice, and build the branded slide deck using the Cosmic SaaS design system).

IMPORTANT: Do not ask any clarifying questions. Determine the target audience, focus, and angle yourself from the source material and the AlfredAI brand context (mid-market construction firms and decision-makers). Proceed directly to producing the final eBook.

IMPORTANT: Generate all images/graphics using Nano Banana Pro (the built-in image generation tool).

LOGO (mandatory - use the OFFICIAL AlfredAI logo): Use the official AlfredAI logo asset bundled in your skill (the composite logo / logo template that ships with the skill). Composite that exact asset. Do NOT generate, redraw, recreate, or approximate the logo with an image model. Do NOT put any black box, dark rectangle, colored panel, or solid shape behind it - it is a transparent wordmark and the background must show through around the letters. If it appears low-contrast, the only allowed enhancement is a soft feathered glow, never a filled box.

'+titleLine+'Source material (read fully):
'+d.source_media+'

PRE-SHIP QUALITY CHECK (mandatory - do this BEFORE uploading anything to Google Drive): Before you upload, review the entire eBook end to end and verify ALL of the following. Do NOT upload until every item passes; if any fails, fix it and re-render first.
1. TEXT CORRECTNESS: all copy is accurate, spelled correctly, grammatically clean, and factually consistent with cited sources. Citations are present and correctly formatted. No placeholder text, no lorem ipsum, no cut-off words.
2. NO OVERLAP: on every page/slide, no text overlaps other text, graphics, the logo, or page edges. Everything sits inside safe margins. Nothing is clipped or running off-page.
3. READABILITY: every text element is legible against its background with strong contrast. Heading and body sizes are consistent and appropriate. No text too small or crowded.
4. GRAPHICS CORRECT: all graphics, charts, icons, colors, and the logo are correct, on-brand, not distorted, not duplicated, and relevant to the content. The AlfredAI logo is the official asset, transparent, with no box behind it.
5. LAYOUT: consistent alignment, spacing, and page order; title page and CTA page correct; no blank or broken pages.
6. COMPLETENESS: all chapters, the references block, and every intended page are present in the final PDF.
Only once every check passes, proceed to upload.

UPLOAD (MANDATORY - this is a required final step, do not skip it):
DESTINATION_FOLDER_ID: '+folderId+'
DESTINATION_FOLDER_URL: '+folderUrl+'
OUTPUT_FILENAME: '+fileName+'

Export the final eBook as a single PDF named '+fileName+'. After the quality check passes, you MUST upload it to the user's Google Drive using rclone, targeting the EXISTING destination folder by its ID. Use the rclone flag --drive-root-folder-id '+folderId+' so the PDF lands directly INSIDE that existing folder. The destination is a shared drive, so also include shared-drive support. Run the upload EXACTLY ONCE; do not re-run or duplicate. Do NOT create a new folder. Do NOT use the folder ID as a new folder name. Do NOT leave the file only in your task workspace - it must end up inside the existing Drive folder with ID '+folderId+'. After uploading, confirm in your task output the exact file you placed in that folder and provide its Drive link.';
return{json:{...d,manus_message:msg,output_filename:fileName}};
